verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents user-controlled deletion in two places: the API example removes your files from Zamzar's servers after conversion, and all users can delete files before their expiry point. That implies a default retention period that users can shorten. However, the evidence never states the retention window or offers any way to configure retention beyond deleting early, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documented retention period length, configurable retention settings or policy controls, explicit API deletion endpoint docs, independent or hands-on verification of deletion.
